name: phosphor-relay-style
tagline_zh: 纯属好玩，装了不亏：phosphor-relay-style。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Create Phosphor Relay images — photographs of a live broadcast re-shot off a glowing screen, where the display's phosphor grid is the dominant material. Use when the user asks for CRT/screen re-photography, broadcast stills, lo-fi sports or televised imagery, signal-decay aesthetics, or scanline-grid photographic treatments.
